d:
Watch the official music video for “Everybody Wanna Be In Love” by Calvin Fallo, a feel-good South African release blending Amapiano, Afro House, soulful rhythm and warm storytelling.
Everybody Wanna Be In Love captures a universal feeling, the desire to love, be loved and experience real connection. With smooth vocals, uplifting production and a dance-ready groove, Calvin Fallo delivers a song that speaks to romance, emotion and the joy of music that brings people together.
